Above all, agility training should be performed in an environment and manner that simulates the conditions and demands of the competition as closely as possible. If the athletes are regularly required to perform lateral cuts followed by short bursts of speed in games or matches, then these movement sequences should be replicated in training. In contrast, if athletes are not required to transition from backpedaling to forward sprinting in their sport, then there is no need to include these tasks as regular elements in the training program.
